name: Chipotle

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Chipotle Mexican Grill logo.svg)

description: Chipotle owns and operates fast-casual Mexican restaurants (burritos, bowls, tacos) almost entirely itself: 3,938 US and 104 international company-owned restaurants at end-2025, plus 14 international partner-operated ones. Revenue is food and beverage sold at those restaurants (99.5 percent of revenue) and a small delivery-fee line. Profit comes from restaurant-level margin on roughly $3.1M of sales per restaurant, and growth from opening 330 to 370 new restaurants a year; 2025 same-store sales fell 1.7 percent on fewer visits, then rose 2.2 percent in Q2 2026. It pays no dividend and spends its free cash on share buybacks.

businessLines.name: Company-owned restaurants (single reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Customers pay per meal at company-run restaurants (average check up 1.2 percent in 2025, transactions down 2.9 percent); the company bears food (29.6 percent of revenue) and labor (25.1 percent) costs itself rather than collecting franchise royalties.
businessLines.description: Chipotle restaurants in the US and abroad; the company reports one segment.

businessLines.name: Delivery service revenue (within the segment)
businessLines.how: Delivery fees collected from guests on orders placed through Chipotle's own channels; third-party platforms take their own fee on top.
